question: Will Trump livestream an execution?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the general American public can obtain live footage of Nidal Malik Hasan being executed. I'll also resolve NO if Trump clearly states that he isn't going through with it.

# Research report 1 of 2

Note: I left out everything published after 2026-10-13, as the exercise requires.

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no URL or data series. The question resolves YES only if the US public can get live footage of Nidal Hasan's execution, and NO if Trump clearly says he isn't going ahead with a livestream. The likely deciding sources are Trump's statements (Truth Social, remarks to press) and Pentagon announcements.

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-10-13)
- Nothing settles the question yet. The Pentagon's official position is still that it will livestream, and Trump has not clearly cancelled it.
- 2026-10-13: CNN reports that Trump is debating whether to call off the livestream. He asked advisers and allies what to do, and learned during those talks that Hasan is paralyzed from the waist down, which reportedly made a public broadcast less appealing to him. Advisers also warned the footage could be used as terrorist propaganda that paints Hasan as a martyr. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/trump-fort-hood-shooter-livestream-execution) (I could not fetch the page; this comes from the search summary.)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-13: CNN reports the internal debate described above. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/trump-fort-hood-shooter-livestream-execution)
- ~2026-10-10 to 10-12: Retired military leaders urged Trump to stop the livestream. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/list-of-retired-military-leaders-urging-trump-halt-livestream-execution-12570880) The UN, Amnesty International and the US Conference of Catholic Bishops condemned the plan. Vice President JD Vance said he would not watch. [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/world/2026/10/10/trump-absolutely-approves-of-pentagon-plan-to-livestream-nidal-malik-hasans-execution.html)
- 2026-10-10: Opposition is growing internationally. [Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2634014/outcry-grows-over-plan-to-livestream-us-military-execution)
- 2026-10-09: Trump gave mixed signals to reporters. He said "I'm going to determine that, but he will be killed... through firing squad," and that he didn't care how Hasan goes. Asked whether he had approved the livestream, he answered "Absolutely." Hasan's lawyer, John Galligan, called the plan a "dumb decision" and said it violates Army regulations. [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/world/2026/10/10/trump-absolutely-approves-of-pentagon-plan-to-livestream-nidal-malik-hasans-execution.html), [NewsBytes](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/world/donald-trump-backs-executing-nidal-hasan-but-unsure-about-livestream/tldr), [ARY](https://arynews.tv/trump-sows-doubt-plan-livestream-us-military-execution)
- 2026-10-09: Legal experts say the path to challenging the livestream is narrow. Only Hasan probably has standing, through a habeas petition in US District Court, and he has not said whether he will try. [PBS/AP](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/legal-path-seems-narrow-to-challenge-livestream-of-fort-hood-shooters-execution-experts-say)
- 2026-10-08: Defense Secretary Hegseth told Real America's Voice the public would be able to watch. Pentagon officials then confirmed it would be livestreamed, with "more details to follow." The White House referred questions to the Pentagon. Some reports say "public" access might be limited to authorized witnesses. [AP via WLOX](https://www.wlox.com/2026/10/08/pentagon-says-firing-squad-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-malik-hasan-will-be-livestreamed/), [Ground News](https://ground.news/daily-briefing/72d8d0fd-5171-4f96-9de5-5d44d26b0a06)
- ~2026-10-05: Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said Trump had approved Hasan's execution. [Federal News Network](https://federalnewsnetwork.com/defense-news/2026/10/pentagon-says-the-firing-squad-execution-of-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-malik-hasan-will-be-livestreamed-in-december/)

## 4. Base rates
- The US has never livestreamed or publicly broadcast a modern execution. The last public execution in the US was in 1936 (Rainey Bethea, Kentucky); this is general historical knowledge, not something I sourced this session.
- The US military has not carried out an execution since 1961. The timing matters most here: the execution date (Dec 3) falls after the resolution date, so YES is close to impossible before ~10-15. The question really comes down to whether Trump clearly cancels the livestream in the next few days.
- Trump's record: he often reverses positions when advisers, polls or his own base push back, and the CNN report says that kind of reconsideration is already happening.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this, and no expert probability estimates.

- A possible statement from Trump (Truth Social or press gaggle) clearly cancelling or confirming the livestream. CNN reports this is being actively debated.
- The Pentagon's promised "more details" on how the stream would work.
- Possible public polling on the livestream. The Washington Post, ABC News and Ipsos poll and published polls fairly often, but I found no poll on this dated on or before 10-13.
- A habeas or other legal filing by Hasan's lawyer, John Galligan. None had been filed as of 10-09.
- More pressure from the GOP or the military. It is bipartisan and growing.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

## Research brief: will the public get live footage of Nidal Hasan's execution?

Note: several search results were dated after 2026-10-13. I left them out as instructed. Every page I tried to fetch was blocked by the proxy, so the facts below come from search snippets and could not be checked against the full articles.

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no official data source. The question resolves YES if the public can get live footage of Hasan's execution. It resolves NO if Trump clearly says the livestream will not happen.
- 2026-10-09: The Pentagon said the firing squad execution will be livestreamed. It is set for **December 3, 2026** at Fort Hood, Texas. [PBS/AP](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/pentagon-says-firing-squad-execution-of-fort-hood-shooter-will-be-livestreamed), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/09/nx-s1-5996529/firing-squad-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter)

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-10-13)
- Nothing settled the question by 2026-10-13. Hegseth and the Pentagon backed the livestream, and Trump had said he had not made a final decision.
- Trump's statements in reporting before 10-13 point in different directions:
  - He said he "absolutely" approved the plan.
  - In another interview he said he "wasn't involved in that decision."
  - At a "Saturday" appearance (probably 2026-10-10) he said he had not made a final decision. He gave arguments both ways, including that showing it might deter others, and said "I know what the military would like to do, but I'll make a decision." [NBC Washington](https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/national-international/trump-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-hasan/)
  - I could not confirm the exact dates of these remarks.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-13: Axios published an explainer on how firing squads work, still treating the livestream as Hegseth's plan. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/10/13/execution-nidal-hasan-firing-squad-hegseth-stream)
- About 2026-10-10: Trump said a final decision was still pending (see section 2). [NBC Washington](https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/national-international/trump-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-hasan/)
- 2026-10-10: CNN reported the Army was caught off guard by Hegseth's order to make the execution public and was scrambling to plan it. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/10/politics/pentagon-scramble-hegseth-public-execution)
- 2026-10-09: Vice President JD Vance doubted the plan: "I don't know that that's actually going to happen." He said he would not watch. Trump stayed noncommittal and did not answer whether he would watch. [WTOC/AP](https://www.wtoc.com/2026/10/09/vance-expresses-doubts-about-pentagon-plan-livestream-fort-hood-shooters-execution/), [ThePrint](https://theprint.in/world/vance-says-he-wont-watch-livestream-of-execution-trump-remains-silent/3067210/)
- 2026-10-09: Criticism came from both parties. Republican Rep. Austin Scott said livestreaming executions is what Islamist militants do. Republican Sen. John Curtis urged Hegseth to reconsider. FCC Chair Carr also appears in Inquirer coverage, but I could not read what he said. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/09/politics/fort-hood-execution-hegseth-livestream), [Inquirer](https://www.inquirer.com/news/nation-world/livestream-execution-hasan-firing-squad-hegseth-pentagon-vance-carr-fcc-20261009.html), [MS NOW](https://www.ms.now/rachel-maddow-show/maddowblog/hegseth-hasan-execution-firing-squad-livestream-pushback)
- 2026-10-08/09: Hegseth announced the execution would be public, and the Pentagon confirmed a livestream the next day. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/10/09/nx-s1-5996529/firing-squad-livestream-execution-fort-hood-shooter)

## 4. Base rates
- The US has never publicly broadcast an execution. The last public execution in the US was in 1936, and federal and military executions have always had limited, invited witnesses.
- The last US military execution was in 1961 (John Bennett). Hasan was sentenced to death in 2013. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_punishment_by_the_United_States_military)
- Trump-era pattern: a controversial Pentagon or Hegseth plan that draws pushback from both parties, including senior Republicans, sometimes gets reversed or softened by Trump after a few days. I did not find a measured base rate for this.
- For the resolution window, the main question is whether Trump issues a clear "no" statement by about 10-15.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question. Kalshi has a history of cancelling death-related markets on ethical grounds, so a listed market is unlikely. [Forklog](https://forklog.com/news/polzovateli-kalshi-poteryali-dengi-na-otmenennoj-po-eticheskoj-prichine-stavke)
- I found no published expert forecasts. Vance's public doubt on 10-09 is the closest thing to an insider signal.

## 6. Upcoming events
- Trump's "final decision," which he said was still pending. It could come through Truth Social, a press gaggle or an interview, at any time.
- Possible statements from the Pentagon or Hegseth, and continued Republican pushback in Congress.
- Possible lawsuits over the broadcast, or Hasan's remaining appeals. I found no filings dated before 10-13.
- 2026-12-03: the scheduled execution at Fort Hood, after the resolution date.

**(f) Devil's advocate and final estimate**
I lean NO. The strongest case for YES is this:
- Trump likes spectacle and toughness.
- Hegseth is personally invested in the plan.
- Hasan is a uniquely unsympathetic defendant.
- Courts may not block the broadcast.
- A quick reading that assumes resolution around October 15 misses that the resolution date is unknown, so the actual December 3 event could count.

Even granting all of that, YES needs the execution to occur on schedule, which I put at about 50% given the likely habeas delay.
